1.

Bring all doubt to Jesus, Take His promise as it stands. Never shall he come to shame Who in faith to Him goes.

C.

I trust, fully trust, Yes, I rely on His word. I trust, fully trust, Yes, I rely on His word.

2.

Bring all your sin to Jesus, He will clothe you in festal robe. In His word He will cleanse you And bring you home to God.

3.

Lay all care on Jesus, He gives rest to the weary. Though your path goes through dark valleys, The sun of grace never sets.

4.

Bring all your joy to Jesus, He gives life a new form. He is Lord of all worlds, With Him you find all.

5.

Give yourself, your all to Jesus, Both spirit, soul, and body, What you have and what you gain, All your longing and your hope. I trust, etc.
